entries.title: CPU busy per processor
entries.description: Measure report of busy percentage and state for every processor.

entries.title: Change a server class's maximum servers
entries.description: Sets MAXSERVERS for a Pathway server class.
entries.side_effects: Allows PATHMON to start more (or fewer) dynamic servers
entries.risks: More servers add CPU and disk load; ATM-AUTH above 40 makes $DATA03 the bottleneck (C-004)

entries.title: Change a server class's static server count
entries.description: Sets NUMSTATIC for a Pathway server class; PATHMON starts or stops static servers to match.
entries.tier_rules: T1 for normal classes, T2 for critical
entries.side_effects: Starts additional server processes on the least-busy CPUs in the class's CPU list
entries.risks: Adds CPU load where the new servers land; never exceed MAXSERVERS

entries.title: Server class configuration
entries.description: Configured CPU list, NUMSTATIC, MAXSERVERS and MAXLINKS of a server class.

entries.title: Server class statistics
entries.description: Requests per second and average and maximum response time of a server class.

entries.title: PATHMON status
entries.description: Primary and backup processor and state of the PATHMON process $PM1.

entries.title: Server class status
entries.description: Running servers, NUMSTATIC, MAXSERVERS, links, queued requests and average response time for a server class.

entries.title: Disk path status
entries.description: Path state of both mirror halves of a disk volume.

entries.title: Reload a processor
entries.description: Reloads a halted processor. Human-only, outside Baton.
entries.risks: Destructive or outage-capable: human-only, outside Baton
entries.escalation: Call HPE hardware support with the evidence pack

entries.title: Activate a process
entries.description: Resumes a suspended process.
entries.risks: Adds the process's load back to its CPU

entries.title: Change a process's priority
entries.description: Changes the execution priority of a process.
entries.side_effects: The process gets more or less CPU relative to others
entries.risks: Too low a priority can starve the process

entries.title: Processes on a CPU
entries.description: Lists the processes running in one processor with their priority and busy share.

entries.title: Process status
entries.description: State, primary and backup CPU and priority of one process or process pair.

entries.title: Stop a process
entries.description: Stops a process. Not reversible from Baton.
entries.tier_rules: T2, not reversible; denied if protected
entries.side_effects: The process ends; its work is lost unless it restarts
entries.risks: Not reversible; the owner must restart it

entries.title: Suspend a process
entries.description: Suspends a process; it does no work until ACTIVATE.
entries.tier_rules: T1 if batch; denied if protected; otherwise T2
entries.side_effects: The process stops consuming CPU until it is activated
entries.risks: Work done by the process waits until ACTIVATE

entries.title: TMF audit trail status
entries.description: Fill percentage of the master audit trail with its overflow and begin-transaction-disable thresholds.

entries.title: TMF status
entries.description: TMF state, transactions per second and abort rate.

entries.title: Stop TMF
entries.description: Stops the transaction monitor. Human-only, outside Baton.
entries.risks: Destructive or outage-capable: human-only, outside Baton
entries.escalation: Call the TMF expert (Maria); never stop TMF to relieve audit pressure (C-009)

body.title: CPU loss at peak
body.tip: The noon statement batch $STMT1 on CPU 5 is safe to suspend during peaks; resume after 13:00.
steps: Rule out audit pressure early on peak days (C-007).
tacl.suspend_process: CPU 5 is the hottest survivor between 11:00 and 13:00
Never reload the CPU yourself. Call HPE hardware support with the evidence pack.

claims.statement: $STMT1 is safe to suspend 11:00–13:00 on peak days; resume after 13:00.
claims.author: Dave

claims.statement: After losing a CPU at peak, add ATM-AUTH static servers on the least-busy CPUs before touching MAXSERVERS.
claims.author: Dave

options.label: Suspend the noon statement batch $STMT1
options.risks: Statements wait until ACTIVATE; resume after 13:00 to meet the 18:00 deadline (C-001)

options.label: Raise ATM-AUTH static servers from 20 to 28
options.expected_effect: Queue clears and p95 returns to band within about 2 minutes
options.risks: Adds load on CPUs 1 and 6; must stay at or below MAXSERVERS 32 (PATHWAY 2049)

options.label: Reload CPU 3

options.risks: Combined risks of A and B

options.label: Do nothing
options.expected_effect: ATM p95 above 1,200 ms within 10 minutes
options.risks: Timeouts reach 5–8%: customers see failed withdrawals
